title: Fix compressed-air leaks
finding: Leak test shows 30.4% of compressor capacity lost to leaks (target ≤10%).
action: Ultrasonic leak survey, then fix fittings, hoses and drain valves. Re-test monthly.

title: Stop air compressor running after hours
finding: Ran 9.3 h with no production in this period (175.0 kWh, ₹1,254).
action: Add a timer or interlock so it stops with the line; add it to the shift-end checklist.

title: Repair the APFC capacitor panel
finding: Power factor fell from 0.98 to 0.92 since 2026-09-10: likely failed capacitor steps in the APFC panel (about 75 kVAR missing).
action: Replace failed capacitor steps (~75 kVAR) and contactors; check the APFC relay.

title: Retrofit a variable-speed drive on the compressor
finding: The compressor spends a lot of time running unloaded (250.7 kWh at ~11.0 kW doing no useful work).
action: Fit a variable-speed drive so output follows demand. Fix leaks first, then re-evaluate.

title: Inspect the cooling pump motor
finding: Current imbalance is 3.05% and rising 0.45%/day. At this rate it reaches alarm level in ~4 days.
action: Check terminal connections, supply voltage balance and bearings before it fails.
